authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual fidelity with realistic fur textures and lighting. However, significant structural artifacts undermine authenticity: (1) Fusion between back-row koalas creates ambiguous boundaries where individual animals merge at shoulders/heads; (2) Central koala's left paw shows digit fusion/malformation inconsistent with natural anatomy; (3) Animal pose auditor reports HIGH artifact risk with 48% low-confidence keypoints across all instances, particularly in limbs and face regions; (4) Topology boundary auditor mask confidence is high (0.97) but this reflects coherent segmentation of fused regions rather than anatomical correctness. The fine-grained classifier's misidentification of koalas as 'teddy bears' further suggests the generated forms lack species-specific anatomical precision. These issues indicate AI-generated structural inconsistencies despite surface-level realism.
key_defects: Fusion artifact between back-row koalas creating ambiguous boundaries
Digit fusion/malformation on central koala's left paw
High pose keypoint uncertainty (48% low-confidence) indicating widespread structural anomalies
Classifier misidentifies koalas as teddy bears suggesting lack of species-specific anatomical fidelity
